name: helpdesk
description: Public tuning task close to ARC difficulty: a helpdesk web app built over 2 stages on the same code, with roles and permissions (admin, agent, customer), forms with exact validation messages, ticket lists with filters, a status workflow, internal notes and a dashboard. Requirements and tests are public (source/), written for this platform (not from ARC). Scored with Playwright browser tests (14 / 11).
